written.myAnswer: Natural systems occur in nature and operate according to natural laws without being created by humans; examples include forests and rivers. Artificial systems are designed and made by people for particular functions or purposes, such as bridges and machines.

Natural systems occur in nature, are governed by natural laws and processes, and function without being designed by humans; examples include forests, rivers and ecosystems. Artificial systems are designed and created by people to perform tasks, meet needs, improve efficiency or solve problems; examples include bridges, machines and water-treatment plants.
